'''Kameria''' was the only [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]]. It was also the location of the [[Royal Naval Yards]].<ref name="Den of Spies">{{WEGCite|story=Den of Spies|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
